cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Lab Calm Bell
cards.toneSkill: shift a neutral line into calm or lively tone
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sticky note story tone card for revising one tidepool lab sentence so the reader hears a calmer or livelier mood on the page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside one blank sticky note and name the whole tidepool scene as invented paper play before writing begins: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: start with the neutral tidepool line, choose a tone, then change words, objects, place cues, and gestures to match it: ____________________.
cards.neutralLinePrompt: Neutral line: The tidepool timekeeper moved the shell note to the tray. Copy or change the line before choosing a tone: ____________________.
cards.toneChoicePrompt: Tone choice: Pick calm, curious, lively, or careful for the shell-note moment, then circle the tone you want the reader to feel: ____________________.
cards.wordChoicePrompt: Word choice: Replace moved with a tone-matching verb such as eased, nudged, flicked, or lined up: ____________________.
cards.objectSignalPrompt: Object signal: Add one shell note, bead dial, tide strip, or paper bell detail that carries the tone: ____________________.
cards.placeCuePrompt: Place cue: Add one pool rim, tray corner, jar label, or tidepool shelf clue that keeps the tone steady: ____________________.
cards.gestureTonePrompt: Gesture tone: Show the timekeeper's tone with one hand, chin, pencil, or shoulder movement: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: With the chosen tone, write: The tidepool timekeeper ____________________.
cards.reviseTonePrompt: Revise tone: Change two words so the same shell-note action feels calmer, livelier, or more careful: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the revised tone sentence on one sticky note and underline the strongest tone word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Try another tidepool sentence where a shell object changes the tone without naming the mood: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Patient Wake
cards.toneSkill: make a revision moment sound patient or playful
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sticky note story tone card for changing a neutral ferry revision line into a patient, playful, or focused sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set one blank sticky note beside a pretend ferry draft card and keep the scene paper-only, fictional, and adult-led: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: choose a tone for the ferry helper, then revise the neutral line with word choice, paper objects, and a clear gesture: ____________________.
cards.neutralLinePrompt: Neutral line: The ferry helper changed the draft sign on the deck. Copy or change the line before setting the tone: ____________________.
cards.toneChoicePrompt: Tone choice: Pick patient, playful, focused, or cheerful for the draft change and mark the tone you will build: ____________________.
cards.wordChoicePrompt: Word choice: Trade changed for adjusted, tucked, straightened, bounced, or another verb that fits your chosen tone: ____________________.
cards.objectSignalPrompt: Object signal: Add one draft sign, folded oar token, rope tag, or ferry note that makes the tone visible: ____________________.
cards.placeCuePrompt: Place cue: Add one deck plank mark, dock card, river margin, or paper rail clue that supports the tone: ____________________.
cards.gestureTonePrompt: Gesture tone: Show the ferry helper's tone with one pause, grin, careful tap, or steady pencil movement: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: With the chosen tone, write: The ferry helper ____________________.
cards.reviseTonePrompt: Revise tone: Change the same ferry action once for patient tone and once for playful tone: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one ferry object and write the tone sentence without adding extra explanation: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Make one new ferry draft sentence where a paper sign changes the tone: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Bright Tag
cards.toneSkill: use label words to make tone formal or playful
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sticky note story tone card for revising a clue-label tower sentence so the label language changes the tone: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this sticky note card beside a made-up museum label strip and remind the writer that every detail belongs to an invented display: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: choose a tower-museum tone, then adjust the label words, object clue, place cue, and keeper gesture to fit it: ____________________.
cards.neutralLinePrompt: Neutral line: The clue keeper placed the label beside the shiny case. Copy or change the line before choosing a tone: ____________________.
cards.toneChoicePrompt: Tone choice: Pick formal, playful, mysterious, or welcoming for the label moment and circle the tone word: ____________________.
cards.wordChoicePrompt: Word choice: Replace placed or shiny with tone-matching words such as arranged, popped, gleaming, or curious: ____________________.
cards.objectSignalPrompt: Object signal: Add one label strip, pointer card, display tag, or clue drawer detail that signals the tone: ____________________.
cards.placeCuePrompt: Place cue: Add one tower shelf, label rail, case corner, or exhibit step that helps the tone feel clear: ____________________.
cards.gestureTonePrompt: Gesture tone: Show the clue keeper's tone with one lean, small nod, careful reach, or pencil hover: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: With the chosen tone, write: The clue keeper ____________________.
cards.reviseTonePrompt: Revise tone: Make the same label sentence formal once and playful once by changing only three words: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw a tiny label box, then write one tone sentence beside it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Write another tower label sentence where the label words set the tone before anything else happens: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Steady Fold
cards.toneSkill: show confident or cautious tone through craft words
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sticky note story tone card for changing a compass-craft sentence so the same action feels confident, cautious, or gentle: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out this card with one blank sticky note and invite a made-up compass-craft scene using only broad invented craft details: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: pick a tone for the compass crafter, then revise the neutral line with one tool word, one place cue, and one gesture: ____________________.
cards.neutralLinePrompt: Neutral line: The compass crafter set the paper needle on the stand. Copy or change the line before choosing a tone: ____________________.
cards.toneChoicePrompt: Tone choice: Pick confident, cautious, gentle, or precise for the paper-needle action and mark your choice: ____________________.
cards.wordChoicePrompt: Word choice: Replace set with balanced, lowered, placed, snapped, or another verb that matches the tone: ____________________.
cards.objectSignalPrompt: Object signal: Add one paper needle, bead marker, folded arrow, or compass card detail that supports the tone: ____________________.
cards.placeCuePrompt: Place cue: Add one craft bench, supply tray, marker rail, or folded-paper stand that makes the tone easier to picture: ____________________.
cards.gestureTonePrompt: Gesture tone: Show the crafter's tone with one steady hand, second check, quick nod, or slow pencil mark: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: With the chosen tone, write: The compass crafter ____________________.
cards.reviseTonePrompt: Revise tone: Rewrite the compass sentence twice so one version sounds confident and one sounds cautious: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: List one tool word first, then write the revised tone sentence below it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Invent another compass-craft line where a tool detail changes the tone: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Warm Clasp
cards.toneSkill: make a page promise feel warm or grand
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sticky note story tone card for revising one binding-day boardwalk sentence so a small page promise sounds warm, grand, or quiet: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside a blank sticky note and keep the page promise small, kind, fictional, and offline: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: choose a tone for the page helper, then revise the neutral line through clasp words, boardwalk cues, and a gentle gesture: ____________________.
cards.neutralLinePrompt: Neutral line: The page helper closed the booklet at the boardwalk stand. Copy or change the line before choosing a tone: ____________________.
cards.toneChoicePrompt: Tone choice: Pick warm, grand, quiet, or proud for the booklet moment and circle the tone you will write: ____________________.
cards.wordChoicePrompt: Word choice: Replace closed with clasped, settled, sealed, tucked, or another verb that matches the tone: ____________________.
cards.objectSignalPrompt: Object signal: Add one booklet clasp, thread loop, promise slip, or page edge detail that carries the tone: ____________________.
cards.placeCuePrompt: Place cue: Add one boardwalk rail, paper booth, booklet stand, or page table clue that keeps the tone grounded: ____________________.
cards.gestureTonePrompt: Gesture tone: Show the page helper's tone with one small nod, lifted chin, careful smile, or gentle page pat: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: With the chosen tone, write: The page helper ____________________.
cards.reviseTonePrompt: Revise tone: Change the booklet sentence once so it feels warm and once so it feels grand: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Pick one clasp clue and write the quieter tone sentence first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Make one more boardwalk sentence where a page detail changes the tone of a kind promise: ____________________.
